title: Create a payout recipient. Provide the target currency, the account type and ban
description: Create a payout recipient. Provide the target currency, the account type and bank details (see /api/public/requirements), the account holder name, and the wallet that will fund the transfer. Returns the recipient id to pass to /api/public/transfer. The recipient is sanctions-screened upstream. Pay 0.01 USDC.

_signals.x_guidance: Typical flow: 1) GET /api/public/quote (targetCurrency + sourceAmount) to get quoteId and the recipient amount. 2) GET /api/public/requirements?currency=... to learn required bank fields (POST /api/public/requirements/refresh to resolve conditional fields). 3) POST /api/public/recipients to create a recipient and get recipientId. 4) POST /api/public/transfer with quote_id + recipientId to get transfer_id and a Base USDC deposit_address. 5) Fund the deposit address, then POST /api/public/confirm-transfer with the tx hash. 6) GET /api/public/transfer-status?id=... to track. Every call costs 0.01 USDC via x402.
